question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ad27171f45d7c3fc563da433ea83eac482dcf61406f45012f0d3ba757281af8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The letters shift positions in a fixed cyclic pattern in every step.

Position movement:

Top-Right → Top-Middle

Top-Middle → Top-Left

Top-Left → Center

Center → Bottom

Bottom → Top-Right

Applying the same pattern to Figure 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7572f1dc4dac09ada883d2aaa3ba76241322fbde03b3c27c4b4b7f4aa323dbf7.png]
